nodes.label: Image 1: 12-Segment Circular Wheel Diagram (Swiss Ephemeris documentation media)
Twelve-Segment Circular Wheel (12-fold division of a circle around a central hub)
nodes.rationale: Schematic diagram showing a circle divided into 12 equal wedge segments (alternating light blue and white) around a central blue hub, enclosed by an outer ring. A 12-fold circular division matches the structure of the twelve zodiac signs as used in Swiss Ephemeris astrology computations; the exact textual source referencing this image was not found in the .htm documentation.
